lines.content: ## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `list-algorithms` returns all solvers with `id`, `name`, `kind`, `description`, `recommendation`, and `params`
- [ ] `get-version` returns the Cargo package version string
- [ ] `solver-config.ts` is deleted — no hardcoded solver list remains in the frontend
- [ ] Step 2 dropdown and config panels render from the WASM response
- [ ] Footer shows grey → green dot sequence on load; version string appears when WASM is ready
- [ ] Footer shows red dot if WASM fails to initialise
- [ ] All existing tests pass; worker integration tests cover `list-algorithms` and `get-version`
- [ ] `teeline-web.yml` CI updated to regenerate JS bindings before npm ci
